decision.question: Does the object corresponding to the small rectangular item near the center of SOURCE visibly change from black to white in EDITED?
decision.criteria: Compare the small rectangular item near the center of SOURCE with the object at that same location and context in EDITED. Pass only if the corresponding object is identifiable and its visible surface changes from black in SOURCE to predominantly white in EDITED. Fail if the corresponding object remains non-white/black, or if the white disc(s) in EDITED are newly appearing objects without visible evidence that the source rectangular item became one. Unknown if the source item cannot be reliably matched or its color/change cannot be judged.
decision.binding: R1 requests changing the black DVD shown in SOURCE; bind the comparison to the source item's location, shape, and context, not merely to any white disc in EDITED.
decision.source_quote: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
decision.endpoint: The source DVD is visibly transformed from black to white.
decision.necessity: The instruction requests a color transformation of the source object. The source image visibly has a small rectangular item near the center, while the edited image has white discs; requiring evidence that the edited white object corresponds to the source item prevents an unrelated or newly appearing disc from satisfying the requested change.
